description: Sensitivity declarations for the types a custom reader emits. These types have no manifest entry, so they have no entry-level `sensitivity` block (req-aws-collector-manifest-6). One row per (entity type, reader). `sensitivity` validates against aws_resource_manifest.schema.json $defs/sensitivity. Location paths use the manifest's path dialect, rooted at the emitted node's TYPED FIELDS (a custom reader stores no configuration envelope), so a path's first segment is a model field. Enforced by the reader at write time (organizations.py, add_node): a type with no row is not written; an `unreviewed` row is not written, because typed fields have no persist_configuration switch, so this mirrors req-aws-collector-manifest-7; and a `credential` location is not written, because a typed field cannot be withheld while the node is kept, so this mirrors req-aws-collector-field-projection-7's credential default.
